name: allowance
description: Allowance: a trust layer that lets AI agents pay with PayPal, within rules you set.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
